title: Homepage Shelf and native icons
notes: The homepage now has a compact Shelf widget backed by the same Shelf store as the full page.
Quick Access was consolidated into Shelf; legacy entries migrate once into Shelf.
A centralized icon resolver handles executables, shortcuts, images, folders and cached icons.

title: Corner island, quick access and motion
notes: Adds a Corner Island presentation mode with the same hover, pin and expansion behavior.
Adds a real quick-access shelf for files, folders and applications with native Windows icons and persistence.
Thought popups now use a seven-second enter/hold/exit cycle.

title: Update channel verification
notes: A small signed-channel verification update. This confirms installed 0.33.0 builds discover, download and install the next published version.
No workflow behavior changed.

title: Cross-application task workflows
notes: Requests that contain both browser and Windows work are split into two workflows instead of stopping after one route.
Each workflow reports its own success or failure; the overall task cannot be marked complete unless both branches verify.
Task details show browser and Windows branch status.

title: Unified mini video editor
notes: Video editing now has one recipe for trim, crop, speed, mute and volume, exported in a single FFmpeg pass.
The playhead can be clicked and dragged anywhere; In/Out handles use pointer capture and have larger hit areas.
Added independent Loop Selection and Focus Selection controls.
PDF and File Studio remain detached from the notch.

title: File Studio is a separate Windows window
notes: Dropping a file on the notch now opens Agent Notch — File Studio in its own resizable Windows window.
The notch has no embedded file editor; it stays compact.
File Studio has a multi-file queue, real image crop/resize/rotate, video trim/crop/mute/speed/snapshot with FFmpeg, and PDF.js rendering with PDF page rotate/delete/duplicate/reorder/save/export.
File Studio uses its own restricted studio API and persists window bounds.

title: Join videos
notes: Join two or more videos locally with FFmpeg concat.

title: Change media speed
notes: Change video/audio playback speed locally (0.5x–2x).

title: Mute and snapshot media
notes: Video/audio File Actions can remove the audio track or save a JPG snapshot.
Original files are never overwritten.

title: Remove metadata locally
notes: File actions can strip metadata from images, PDFs, video and audio and write a clean copy.
Image EXIF is removed by decoding and re-encoding; media uses FFmpeg with -map_metadata -1; PDF document info is cleared.
Original files are never overwritten.

title: Archives and subtitle conversion
notes: File actions now extracts ZIP, TAR, GZ and TGZ archives into a chosen folder with path-traversal and size guards.
SRT and VTT subtitles convert locally in either direction, preserving cue text.
PDF merge/split/rotate and images-to-PDF remain from 0.25.0.

title: Nashi PDF actions in the notch
notes: File actions now handles PDFs: inspect page count, merge multiple PDFs, split every page into its own PDF, and rotate 90°/180°/270°.
PNG/JPEG images can be combined into a PDF from File actions.
All PDF work runs locally through pdf-lib; the source files are never overwritten.

title: The real Blobatar, and files you can drop on the notch
notes: The blob companion now uses the vendored Blobatar library (MIT), with its exact silhouettes, fourteen expressions, hues and a custom seed.
Drop an image, video, audio file or document anywhere on the notch to open File actions with that file loaded.
Added a paperclip button in the header and a Files button on Home, so File actions is visible without opening All Tools.
Vendored the full Nashi and Blobatar repositories under vendor/ with their licenses and upstream commit hashes.

title: Local Whisper joins the offline options
notes: Dictation can now use Local Whisper base.en when the openai-whisper CLI and model are installed.
Groq remains the default. Local (Windows) and Local Whisper are explicit, keyless alternatives.
Whisper runs locally against a temporary WAV; no audio leaves the PC.

title: Convert documents to PDF
notes: File actions now accepts DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF, TXT, PPTX, XLSX and CSV.
When LibreOffice is installed, it converts the document to a new PDF locally; the original is never overwritten.
If LibreOffice is missing, the page explains the requirement. No LibreOffice binary is bundled, so the installer stays under 1 GB.

title: Trim and convert video and audio
notes: File actions now accepts video and audio as well as images.
When FFmpeg is installed, it probes duration/resolution and can trim and convert to MP4 or MP3 locally.
If FFmpeg is missing, the page explains how to add it instead of failing silently. No FFmpeg binary is bundled, so the installer stays under 1 GB.

title: Rotate and flip images in File actions
notes: Image edits now include 90°/180°/270° rotation and horizontal flip, alongside square crop and resize.
All transforms run locally before conversion; the original file is never overwritten.

title: Square crop and the Groq/local voice split
notes: File actions can center-crop an image to a square before converting or resizing.
Groq remains the default assistant and transcription provider; Local (Windows, offline) remains an explicit alternative.
Added regression coverage for the Groq default and the local option.

title: An offline speech option that needs no API key
notes: Dictation and recorded voice can use Local (Windows, offline). It uses the speech recognizer already installed in Windows; audio stays on this PC.
Local speech needs no provider key and no cloud-audio consent. Quality depends on the Windows speech language pack.
Cloud providers remain the default and are unchanged. Whisper/Parakeet model packs are still a separate optional download.

title: Keys leave with the app, lyrics hold still, and the agent gets a face
notes: Uninstall now removes saved API keys, integration secrets and the local agent token even when notes and history are kept.
Lyrics render only the current and previous full lines. The current line no longer restarts its slide for every word.
Settings > Appearance adds a customizable blob companion with shape, hue, expression and a click reaction.
All Tools adds File actions: drop or choose an image, inspect it, convert PNG/JPEG and resize to a new file.
The 0.19.0 PRD covers file editing, offline speech, and the Rune/Astryx evaluations.

title: Clearer lyrics, a quieter chat, and a notch that leaves
notes: Lyrics now show only the current line and the line before it. The current line is larger and bold; the previous line is smaller and faded. No third clipped row.
Chat opens without the “Ask a question” intro. The conversation and composer get the space instead.
The island closes after the pointer leaves, unless it is pinned or voice, capture, a task or a manual terminal session is active.
Settings > About now includes What’s new and the public release history.

title: Automatic updates are live
notes: Checks shortly after startup, every six hours and from Settings.
Downloads in the background, then offers Restart now or Later.
Installs only after the app exits and keeps settings, keys and local data.
Added the public release channel at agent-notch-releases.

title: Installer hand-off hardening
notes: The install helper is created through Windows Management Instrumentation so it survives the app process ending.
SQLite is checkpointed and closed before the installer runs.

title: Verified update test build
notes: Verified the installed 0.17.6 to 0.17.7 update path.
Kept the current updater and data-preservation behavior.

title: First updater-enabled build
notes: Added NSIS automatic updates with electron-updater.
Added Settings and tray update status.
